description: Use the pinned npm onnxruntime-web instead of a vendored ORT copy.
Serve the wasm from /ort/ (self-hosted) instead of the extension URL.
The runtime now runs in a Web Worker, where `document`/`chrome` do not exist.
Host the SentencePiece bundle in a nested Worker instead of a hidden iframe.
The worker message handler lives in ensureTokenizerSandboxFrame now.
postMessage goes to the nested Worker.
The 45 MB encoder is only needed for cloning, so create its session lazily.
Companion method for the lazy codec-encode session.
AudioContext is unavailable in Workers: accept pre-decoded 48 kHz PCM instead.
The codec encoder session is optional now, so warmup must tolerate its absence.
With a Worker instead of an iframe there is no .contentWindow; keeping the upstream check would spawn a fresh tokenizer Worker (and lose the loaded model) on every request.
